card.name: Numbers just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: The last piece of a quantity (a digit, a fraction semicolon, or 'a' in 'half a') right before a unit such as mg, mcg, mL, kg or million is expected. Mostly in dose statements.

modes.label: Final digit of a dose
modes.description: A digit completing a decimal or round dose number just before mg, mcg or ng per kg.

modes.label: Fraction or 'half a'
modes.description: The semicolon ending a fraction code like ½ or the 'a' after half, just before a measure or amount.

card.writes: It favors measure-word continuations such as kilometers, kilograms and grams.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a number when a unit like mg or kg comes next.
